analysis: Coverage limit: the three units are base_text only for docs/reference/configuration.md (lines 1-571). No patch hunks or head_text were supplied, so I could not identify what this PR changes; any conclusion about the diff rests on that missing evidence. The file is documentation only, so no executable behavior changes on its own. Base content a later pass should compare against the diff: (1) Provider endpoint resumption and logout, lines 67-88 (A-008, TB-011, T-053): logout uses issuer metadata bound to the saved token and ignores --config, and endpoint-resumption protocol 1 creates no local trust. (2) Worker qualification flags, lines 127-143: DARKBLOOM_APP_ATTEST_WORKER_QUALIFICATION and DARKBLOOM_NATIVE_APP_ATTEST_QUALIFICATION need exact '1' and are internal opt-ins (TB-011, T-052, T-054). (3) SSD prefix cache and storage keys, lines 473-504 (T-041, SEC-035, A-001): the 1800-second TTL ceiling, cache.directory with volume_uuid, daily_write_gb, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL, TEST_ROOT and TEST_PERSISTENT_KEY. (4) Runtime metallib TMPDIR handling, lines 31-46: TMPDIR validation fails snapshot creation without fallback, and TMPDIR is not forwarded to launchd. Watch for a diff that raises the TTL past 1800 seconds, loosens the ephemeral-key or test-root gating, or states that environment flags grant trust or authorization (T-052, T-053). Likewise watch for docs claiming the LaunchAgent forwards variables it does not, or for drift between the documented env allow-lists and LaunchAgent.swift. Unchanged source callers were not examined.
